name: Location Owner
summary: Creates a private location profile and owns location-specific wildlife data.
description: Defines the location-specific candidate species scope so the system starts from fauna that plausibly occur at a precise place. Uses location.initialize to normalize supplied occurrence facts into a deterministic policy set and to reject incomplete source records before they influence downstream detection logic.

distinguished_from.how: Defines the scope of valid local species and source records; does not primarily run microphones or manage capture operations.
Sets the initial location policy and source facts, while the reviewer adjudicates uncertain evidence and unknown sounds afterward.
